Privacy Policy

How website enquiries and measurement information should be handled.

This is a business draft for professional legal review before launch. It does not claim compliance with a specific jurisdiction.

Information we collect

We may collect details you submit through consultation, contact, newsletter and measurement forms, including contact information, preferences, appointment requests and garment measurements.

How information is used

Information is used to answer enquiries, arrange appointments, prepare tailoring recommendations, provide requested services and improve the website. Marketing messages should only be sent where appropriate consent has been provided.

Cookies and analytics

The website may use essential cookies, analytics and advertising measurement after those services are configured. A consent mechanism should be added where required.

Retention and security

Keep personal and measurement data only as long as necessary for the stated purpose. Secure all connected form, booking and storage services and restrict access.

Your choices
